title: Conservation of Galaxias pedderensis. Inland Fisheries Commission Occasional Report 92-01
why_it_matters: Primary source for 1988-1991 surveys, life history, museum screening, and captive breeding results repeatedly cited by official documents.
notes: Highest-priority missing source for upgrading the ledger from synthesis to primary extraction.

title: The Pedder galaxias recovery plan: Management Phase
why_it_matters: Likely contains the earliest formal translocation design, founding numbers, and site-selection rationale.

title: Status of galaxiid fishes in Tasmania, Australia: conservation listings, threats and management issues
why_it_matters: Would strengthen statewide comparative context and likely sharpen proxy evidence across other Tasmanian galaxiids.

title: Effects of habitat structure and the presence of brown trout on the population density of Galaxias truttaceus in Tasmania, Australia
why_it_matters: Strong Tasmania-based proxy for trout effects on another native galaxiid.

title: Primary study behind the Taieri River brown trout and Galaxias vulgaris exclusion pattern
why_it_matters: Would allow direct use of the exclusion dataset rather than relying on review-level summary.
notes: The Environment Australia salmonids review provides the key result but not the full methodological detail.

title: Food and space interactions between Galaxias brevipinnis and juvenile trout in New Zealand
why_it_matters: Potentially useful for competitive-encounter or diel-activity assumptions involving climbing galaxias and trout.

title: Inland Fisheries Commission annual reports and stocking logs for Lake Pedder
why_it_matters: Would verify the 350,000 fry release, trout growth chronology, and any additional stockings.

title: Curated museum-lot export for Pedder galaxias and climbing galaxias records from TMAG, QVMAG and Museums Victoria
why_it_matters: Needed to turn the museum-screening insight into a specimen-level chronology with dates, counts, and taxonomic certainty.
notes: ALA already shows promising locality/year structure, but not enough curation for direct modeling use.

title: The fauna of Lake Pedder: changes after the flooding and thoughts on restoration
why_it_matters: Best target for parameterizing the productivity pulse and habitat-change null model more directly.
